description: TCE test profiles for `/skill:test --type`. `full` is deliberately omitted so a bare invocation resolves to the genuine full CI suite (`npm --silent test`) and populates the audit-accepted full-suite cache entry. See the sibling SKILL_PREFIX.md for the stage-selection policy. Browser-dependent types chain scripts/check-browser-test-env.ts before Vitest; every typed Vitest command runs through scripts/vitest-run-with-retry.ts (retry-once + wall-clock hang timeout) with the default reporter (human summary + retry detection) plus the flat-TAP reporter (scripts/vitest-tap-reporter.ts) so red runs triage per test.

smoke: bash -c 'npx tsx scripts/check-browser-test-env.ts && npx tsx scripts/vitest-run-with-retry.ts --project smoke --reporter=default --reporter=./scripts/vitest-tap-reporter.ts'
dev: bash -c 'npx tsx scripts/check-browser-test-env.ts && npx tsx scripts/vitest-run-with-retry.ts --project dev --reporter=default --reporter=./scripts/vitest-tap-reporter.ts'
browser: bash -c 'npx tsx scripts/check-browser-test-env.ts && npx tsx scripts/vitest-run-with-retry.ts --project browser --timeout-ms 900000 --reporter=default --reporter=./scripts/vitest-tap-reporter.ts'
